meta.measured_note: bin/dissect found 22 shots; frame checks found 3 missed hard cuts (9.30, 16.43, 18.77), so the source has 25 shots (average 1.20 s). Letterboxed 1.85:1 inside 16:9 (black bars 2.0% of height top and bottom); positions are % of the full 16:9 frame.
meta.letterbox: 1.85:1 picture, black bars 22 px of 1080 (2.0%) top and bottom

acts.name: The match
acts.function: Hook and tension: the commentator calls it, fans everywhere clutch the drink and wait; whistle, 'It'll be a free kick.'

acts.name: The held breath
acts.function: Time stops inside the drink: a bubble, fizz, a drop falling into the glass; the sound drains to silence.

acts.name: The goal
acts.function: The drop lands and the world erupts: pupil, screams, toasts, sprays, pours; 'Oh, what a goal! Ecstasy, euphoria!'

acts.name: Overflow
acts.function: Emotion overflows: a droplet on the bottle matches a tear; she drinks by the sea; tagline.

acts.name: End card
acts.function: Product macro under the brand lockup.

look.grade: Warm, naturalistic and filmic. Tension shots are low-key with teal-green shadows and warm skin; the only saturated colour is the product red. Product macros sit in near-black voids. The goal section opens up into daylight: warm sun at the sea, soft overcast in the street, golden sunset.
look.contrast: Medium-high: deep but not crushed blacks, highlights only on practicals, glass and sun.
look.light: Motivated practicals inside (lamp, TV glow, fairy lights, window strips), hard sun outside, rim and backlight on every product macro.
look.depth_of_field: Shallow everywhere (85-100 mm close-ups and macros, f/1.4-2.8 feel); only s19 and s20 hold some depth.
look.grain: Fine film-like grain, slight halation on highlights; no haze or smoke.
look.brightness: Measured 0-255: the match (s01-s08) 30-64; the held breath (s09-s11) 11-17; the goal interiors 39-83, street and sunset exteriors 66-149 (s20 peaks at 149); overflow 52-124 (seafront s23-s24 at 83-124); end card 65-95.
look.frame: Letterboxed 1.85:1 inside 16:9 (black bars 2.0% of height top and bottom); positions are % of the full 16:9 frame.

text_style.typeface: Tagline: a regular-weight transitional serif (set/font_serif.ttf, tracked -6%) in sentence case, followed by the {BRAND} wordmark in a bold grotesk (set/font_sans.ttf) caps. Lockup: bold sans wordmark in a square brand tile; partner line in small bold caps.
text_style.case: Tagline sentence case + wordmark caps; partner line all caps
text_style.size: Tagline: serif ascender height 6.7% H, wordmark cap height 7.0% H, one baseline at 53.0% H, group centred at 50% W. Lockup: brand tile 10.2% W square; partner line cap height 1.0% H, tracking +12%.
text_style.position: Centred on frame; exact layouts in set/ui_tagline.png, set/ui_end_card.png and set/ui.json
text_style.animation: None: both cut in with their shot and hold until the cut / the end. No captions, no supers, no lower-thirds anywhere else; the commentator's monitor shows a match with no score bug.

sound.music: set/score.wav is the film's full mix (voice, crowd, effects and music in one track). 0.00-6.05 stadium murmur bed (-23 to -18 LUFS) with a low hum at 2.9-3.8 | 6.05-6.65 referee's whistle (pure tone ~3.7 kHz) | 7.4-10.2 the crowd's tension swells to -12 LUFS, a sharp hit at 9.88 | 10.2-14.0 everything drains away exponentially to near silence (-45 LUFS at 13.6-14.0): the held breath | 14.04 SLAM: crowd roar and music enter at once (-44 -> -14 dB in 40 ms) as the drop lands | 14.0-23.5 warm swelling anthem (sustained chords, no hard drum grid) under cheering, -12 to -17 LUFS | 23.5-29.5 music alone under the drink and end card, -16/-17 LUFS | 29.5-30.03 eases out to silence.
sound.speech: One voice: a veteran football commentator, close-miked and dry, always on top (-14 to -18 LUFS momentary). On camera only in s01 (from behind); every other line is voice-over over the montage. Five lines: L01 0.28-1.55, L02 6.38-7.42, L03 14.50-15.78, L04 17.70-20.45, L05 21.00-23.15. He builds from a calm observation to an incredulous call to an almost sung, drawn-out delivery on 'Ecstasy, euphoria' and 'emotion overflows'.
sound.effects: Whistle 6.05; whoosh-hit 9.88 on the cut into the bubble; the drop's slam 14.04; crowd throughout. No can-opening or pour sounds are featured on their own.
sound.mix: Voice on top; crowd and music ducked under him; the 4-second drain to silence before the slam is the film's key sound move.

cut30.arc: The whole film: hook (booth, 'This is quite a game.') -> tension (fans clutch the drink at home, bar, terrace; whistle; 'It'll be a free kick.'; can, goosebumps) -> held breath (bubble, fizz, drop into the glass, silence) -> slam and eruption ('Oh, what a goal! Ecstasy, euphoria!': eye, scream, roars, toasts, spray, pour, sunset bottles) -> overflow (droplet = tear, 'And emotion overflows.', she drinks by the sea, tagline) -> lockup.
